title: Cost of one restricted Fourier observation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a finite subset of $	ext{Fin}(n)$, let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$, and let $z$ be a sign assignment on the coordinates outside $J$, while $y,y'$ are sign assignments on $J$. For any Boolean target on the sign cube, running the program that queries the target at the two cube points formed from $(y,z)$ and $(y',z)$ and returns the product of their restricted Fourier observations has the deterministic output equal to that product, evaluated using the two target answers, and cost $(0,2,2+2n+2|S|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: fixed sign assignment z outside J
free sign assignments y and y' on J
Boolean target function on the n-dimensional sign cube
